SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price)*1.0/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),1) AS 客单价 FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.order_id
SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(oi.quantity*(oi.unit_price-p.cost))/SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price),1) AS 毛利率百分比 FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id=p.product_id
SELECT p.category AS 品类, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price),0) AS 销售额 FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id=p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
